items.q: How does CentryAI detect my subscriptions?
items.a: CentryAI lets you manually add subscriptions or import them. It uses pattern recognition to identify recurring charges without ever storing sensitive data.
Zombie subscriptions are services you're actively paying for but haven't marked as used in over 30 days. CentryAI tracks usage (with your permission) to flag these automatically.
Absolutely. CentryAI never connects to your bank account. All data is encrypted and stored locally on your device by default.

items.q: Can CentryAI actually cancel subscriptions for me?
items.a: CentryAI finds the fastest cancellation path for each service — direct cancel link, phone number, or step-by-step instructions. One-tap cancellation is coming in v2.

items.q: Does it work with family sharing plans?
items.a: Yes. CentryAI can detect shared subscriptions and split-cost services, showing you the per-person cost for family plans.
The core tracking features are free. CentryAI Premium unlocks zombie detection, advanced analytics, and renewal alerts.

googleData.title: How we use your Google data
googleData.cardDesc: To automate subscription detection, CentryAI offers an optional Gmail integration. When you choose to connect your account, we request read-only access (gmail.readonly) to your inbox. CentryAI strictly uses this access to scan for subscription receipts and billing emails. All parsing of email metadata is processed to build your financial dashboard only. We never read your personal emails, we do not use your data to train AI models, and your email content is never stored on our servers.

gettingStarted.q: How do I connect my Gmail account?
gettingStarted.a: Open CentryAI, tap "Connect Inbox" on the home screen, and choose Gmail. You'll be taken to Google's sign-in page. Grant read-only permission — CentryAI can only read, never send or delete emails.
Yes. On iOS, tap "Connect Inbox" and choose iCloud. CentryAI will request Mail access via Apple's standard permission dialog.

gettingStarted.q: Can I use CentryAI without connecting an inbox?
gettingStarted.a: Yes — you can add subscriptions manually by tapping the + button. However, auto-detection requires inbox access.

gettingStarted.q: How long does the initial scan take?
gettingStarted.a: Most inboxes complete an initial scan in under 60 seconds. Very large inboxes (10+ years of email) may take 2–3 minutes.

subscriptionsDetection.q: Why is a subscription missing from my list?
subscriptionsDetection.a: CentryAI may miss subscriptions if the billing confirmation was sent to a different email address, is in spam, or uses an unusual format. You can always add missing subscriptions manually.

subscriptionsDetection.q: How does the zombie subscription detector work?
subscriptionsDetection.a: CentryAI cross-references your subscription list with app usage data (with permission) to identify services you haven't opened in 30+ days. On iOS, this uses Screen Time data. On Android, it uses Usage Stats.

subscriptionsDetection.q: Why is my subscription price showing incorrectly?
subscriptionsDetection.a: Prices are extracted from billing emails and may not reflect recent price changes. Tap any subscription to manually edit the price.
Yes. CentryAI detects monthly, annual, quarterly, and any custom billing cycle. Annual subscriptions show a monthly equivalent and a next-renewal alert.

cancellation.q: Can CentryAI cancel subscriptions for me?
cancellation.a: Currently, CentryAI finds the fastest cancellation path — a direct link, phone number, or step-by-step guide — but does not automate the cancellation. One-tap cancellation is on the roadmap for v2.

cancellation.q: The cancel link isn't working. What do I do?
cancellation.a: Cancel links can change when companies update their websites. Tap "Report broken link" on the subscription detail page and we'll update it. In the meantime, try searching "[Service name] how to cancel" for the latest instructions.

privacySecurity.q: Can CentryAI see my email content?
privacySecurity.a: No. CentryAI only reads subject lines, sender addresses, and structured patterns in billing emails. Full email bodies are never read, stored, or transmitted.

privacySecurity.q: Is my data stored on your servers?
privacySecurity.a: No by default. All subscription data is stored locally on your device. You can optionally enable encrypted iCloud/Google Drive backup in Settings > Data & Privacy.

privacySecurity.q: What happens if I delete my account?
privacySecurity.a: Deleting your account immediately removes all data from our servers (if sync was enabled) and from local storage. This action is irreversible. To delete: Settings > Account > Delete Account.

premium.a: Pro unlocks zombie subscription detection, advanced spending analytics, renewal reminders, unlimited manual subscriptions, and priority support. Free tier supports up to 10 tracked subscriptions.

premium.q: How do I cancel my Pro subscription?
premium.a: Pro subscriptions are managed by the App Store or Google Play — not directly by CentryAI. To cancel: iOS: Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. Android: Play Store > Subscriptions.

premium.q: Do you offer a free trial?
premium.a: Yes — new users get a 7-day free trial of CentryAI Premium when they first connect an inbox.

troubleshooting.q: The app is crashing. What should I do?
troubleshooting.a: First, try force-closing and reopening the app. If the issue persists, go to Settings > Support > Send Diagnostic Report. You can also submit a bug report.

troubleshooting.q: My inbox scan is stuck. What do I do?
troubleshooting.a: Pull down to refresh on the home screen. If the scan remains stuck, disconnect and reconnect your inbox from Settings > Connected Accounts. If the problem persists, contact support.

troubleshooting.q: CentryAI isn't detecting new subscriptions after setup.
troubleshooting.a: Ensure background refresh is enabled for CentryAI in your device settings. iOS: Settings > CentryAI > Background App Refresh. Android: Settings > Apps > CentryAI > Battery > Unrestricted.

privacy.shortVersion: CentryAI reads your email to find subscription receipts. Email content is processed server-side in our secure Cloud Functions — we never store your emails, never sell your data, and never connect to your bank.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.emailBody: To detect your subscriptions, CentryAI requests read-only access to your Gmail or iCloud inbox. When you initiate a scan, email content (sender, subject, body snippets) is transmitted to CentryAI's secure Cloud Functions servers for processing. Only extracted subscription data is saved — raw email content is not stored after processing.
s1.accountBody: CentryAI uses Google Sign-In and Apple Sign-In exclusively — we do not collect or store passwords. When you sign in, we receive your email address and display name from your sign-in provider. We do not collect your phone number or payment card details.
s1.usageBody: We collect anonymized, aggregated usage data to improve the app — such as which features are used most often and general performance metrics. We also produce aggregate statistics, for example which subscription services are most popular by country and region, using a one-way pseudonymized identifier. This data cannot be used to identify you and is kept separate from your personal profile.
s1.deviceBody: We collect your device timezone, locale, and app version to deliver timely renewal reminders and ensure compatibility. We also derive your approximate location — country and region only — from your IP address. This lookup runs inside our own backend using an offline database, so your IP address is never sent to any third-party geolocation provider. We do not collect your precise location, city, postal code, or GPS data.
s1.noHumanAccess: 🔒 No human will read your email data. Access is strictly programmatic and automated for the sole purpose of detecting subscriptions.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Detect and display your recurring subscriptions
Identify zombie subscriptions based on usage patterns
s2.noAds: We do not use your data for advertising, and we do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties under any circumstances.
s2.aiNote: 🤖 AI / Machine Learning: We strictly do not use Google Workspace APIs (including Gmail data) to develop, improve, or train generalized AI and/or Machine Learning models.
s2.googlePolicy: CentryAI's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
s2.body:
We use the information we collect to:

  • Detect and display your recurring subscriptions
  • Identify zombie subscriptions based on usage patterns
  • Send renewal reminders (if enabled)
  • Provide customer support
  • Improve app performance and features
  • Comply with legal obligations

s3.title: 3. Data Storage and Security
s3.body1: Your subscription data is stored securely in Firebase Firestore (Google Cloud), a cloud database protected by per-user security rules that prevent any other user from accessing your data.
s3.body2: Email content transmitted during inbox scanning is processed in our Cloud Functions and is not retained after processing completes. Only extracted subscription data is stored in your account.
s3.body3: Our infrastructure uses TLS encryption in transit, Firebase's encryption at rest, and security rules enforcing strict per-user data isolation. Access to your personal data by our team is limited to authorized personnel for customer support and operational purposes only, protected by role-based authentication and recorded in an internal audit log. Retention: if you cancel and do not return, your data is automatically and permanently deleted after 30 days; you can also delete your account and all associated data at any time from within the app.

s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
s4.intro: CentryAI uses a limited number of third-party services:
items: Google Sign-In / Gmail API — authentication and inbox scanning (governed by Google's privacy policy)
Apple Sign-In / iCloud — authentication and inbox scanning (governed by Apple's privacy policy)
Firebase (Google) — cloud database (Firestore), authentication, push notifications (FCM), and server-side processing (Cloud Functions)
Google Gemini AI — AI-powered subscription extraction from email snippets (email data not used for AI training)
RevenueCat — in-app subscription billing management (we never handle payment card details directly)
Resend — transactional email delivery for weekly renewal reminders (email address shared only if you opt in)
s4.noShare: We do not share your personal data with any other third parties.

s5.title: 5. Your Rights
s5.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
items: Access the personal data we hold about you
Request deletion of your account and associated data
Export your data in a portable format
s5.contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@centryai.app. We will respond within 30 days.

s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
s6.body: CentryAI is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us immediately.

s7.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
s7.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes via in-app notification or email at least 14 days before changes take effect. Continued use of the app after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

s8.title: 8. Contact Us
s8.body: Questions about this policy? We're here to help.

deleteAccount.inAppIntro: The fastest way to delete your account and all associated data is directly from the CentryAI app:

steps.title: Open CentryAI and sign in

steps.title: Go to Settings
steps.body: Tap the profile icon or navigate to the Settings tab at the bottom of the screen.

steps.title: Tap “Delete Account”
